title: A bírósági szervezet és az igazságszolgáltatás (The Judicial System & Courts)
grammar: Institutional Governance, Separation of Powers & Public Law in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name the four levels of Hungarian courts and say which is the highest.
I can say that judges are independent and cannot be members of a party.
I can say what the prosecution service does and who elects the Prosecutor General.
I can read a short text about the courts and the prosecution service.
